entities.name: ZV29K
entities.description: The unnamed Tin Street human, the journal's writer, who becomes stronger and smarter under Simic treatment before dissolving into a cytoplastic life form; the Simic call him ZV29K.

entities.name: Raiche Belas
entities.description: A vedalken senior researcher of the Cytoplast Revitalization Project who recruits and experiments on the narrator and Warrik.

entities.name: Warrik
entities.description: An ironmonger's son from Anasis Plaza, about twelve, who is another experimental subject and sickens and disappears.

entities.name: Momir Vig
entities.description: The recipient of Raiche's official communication regarding the Cytoplast Revitalization Project.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The guild that runs the Novijen experiments and offers the narrator induction.

entities.name: Novijen
entities.description: The Simic headquarters where the experiments take place.

entities.name: Cytoplast Revitalization Project
entities.description: The Simic experiment program using human trials to create cytoplastic life forms.

entities.name: Tin Street
entities.description: The street on Ravnica where the narrator lived with his gang before the experiments.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where the story takes place.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild the narrator's father wanted him to join.

entities.name: Gruul Clans
entities.description: An anarchic guild the narrator once feared.

entities.name: Rakdos Cult
entities.description: A guild the narrator once feared for its knives.

entities.name: Boros Legion
entities.description: A guild that would not help the people of Tin Street.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: A ruling guild the narrator reflects on.

entities.name: Selesnya Conclave
entities.description: A guild preaching brotherhood that would do even less to help.

entities.name: Wojek
entities.description: Law enforcers the narrator ran from on the streets.

entities.name: Matty
entities.description: A member of the narrator's Tin Street gang.

entities.name: Gats
entities.description: A member of the narrator's Tin Street gang.

events.summary: The narrator begins keeping a journal at the bio man's request so the treatment's effects can be tracked.
events.quote: the bio guy sez i need to kep a jurnal so we can tel if the stuffs workin.

events.summary: The narrator recounts being recruited from Tin Street by a vedalken who asks if he is happy.
events.quote: Anyways, the Vedalken finally asks me if I'm happy.

events.summary: The narrator rescues Warrik from a mossdog-like experimental creature by choking it and slamming its head on a wall.
Warrik pledges a blood debt to the narrator, and Raiche praises his improvement.
events.quote: Raiche is telling me how I'm supposed to be improving physikally as well as mentally

events.summary: The narrator excels in a running test and has his progress praised.
events.quote: Said that my progres wasnt like anything he'd ever seen.

events.summary: The narrator, now far stronger and smarter, hears whispers of induction into the Simic Combine and considers returning to help Tin Street.
events.quote: I have heard whispers of inducting me into the Simic Combine once the tests are over.

events.summary: The narrator recounts his father turning him out for lacking Izzet aptitude.
events.quote: When it became patently obvious even to him that I didn't have the Izzet aptitude, he turned me out onto the streets.

events.summary: Warrik grows sick and the narrator begins to regress, while Raiche dismisses both as side effects.
events.quote: that Warrik was just feeling a side effect of some treatment

events.summary: The narrator tries to smuggle Warrik out but is blocked by slime creatures; Raiche intervenes and Warrik vanishes.
events.quote: I turn around and Warrick wasnt were I left him.

events.summary: The narrator's mind dulls and he can no longer remember where Warrik is.
events.quote: iv trid to find him but i kant remembr were evrything is now.

events.summary: The narrator's body melts into yellow slime and he fears he is dying.
events.quote: im skared. slim is driping on the skrol.

events.summary: Raiche reports to Momir Vig that ZV29K is now a mindless cytoplastic life form held with the others, and that the human trials are nearly complete.
events.quote: The resulting cytoplastic life form is now kept in the Eastern Holding Facility with the others

relations.note: reports on the project to him
relations.quote: TO: Momir Vig REGARDING: Cytoplast Revitalization Project

relations.note: he saves Warrik and tries to escape with him
relations.quote: I'm not leaving Warrik in this plase.

relations.note: experimented on him until he became a cytoplastic life form
relations.quote: ZV29K persisted in his superior state for a full two weeks longer than all previous subjects.
So he brings me to Novijen, the Simic HQ
